def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Identify connected components by color (4-neighbor).
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((color,cells))
    # The smallest component belonging to the most numerous non-background color is noise.
    totals={}
    for color,cells in comps: totals[color]=totals.get(color,0)+len(cells)
    color=max(totals, key=totals.get)
    target=min((cells for col,cells in comps if col==color), key=len)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in target: out[r][c]=0
    return out
PY
